text: Your account ending XXXX was debited by Rs 450. If you do not recognise this transaction, contact your bank using the official number on your card.
label: legitimate
annotation_note: Neutral transaction alert with no request to disclose secrets.

text: Aapka electricity bill payment receive ho gaya hai. Receipt aapke customer account mein available hai.
label: legitimate
annotation_note: Ordinary payment confirmation with no suspicious action.

text: Kal 5 baje library ke bahar milte hain. Notes bhi le aana.
label: legitimate
annotation_note: Normal personal conversation.

text: Your login verification code is [OTP]. Do not share it with anyone.
label: legitimate
annotation_note: Expected OTP notification explicitly warns not to share the code.

text: Aapka parcel delivery ke liye nikal chuka hai. Delivery status app mein check karein.
label: legitimate
annotation_note: Neutral delivery status with no payment demand or suspicious link.

text: Your appointment is confirmed for 14 November at 3 PM. Reply C to cancel.
label: legitimate
annotation_note: Ordinary appointment reminder.

text: College fee payment of Rs 2500 received. Receipt student portal par available hai.
label: legitimate
annotation_note: Expected educational fee receipt.

text: Aapka mobile recharge successful hai. Plan validity aur details app mein dekh sakte hain.
label: legitimate
annotation_note: Neutral recharge confirmation.

text: Weekend sale: Save up to 40 percent on selected home products. Visit our store this Saturday.
label: spam
annotation_note: Unsolicited retail promotion without deceptive payment or credential request.

text: Hamare coaching centre mein naye batch ki admission shuru hai. Course details ke liye office visit karein.
label: spam
annotation_note: Unsolicited course advertisement without a deceptive fee demand.

text: Cafe ke new menu par 20 percent discount hai. Is weekend friends ke saath visit karo.
label: spam
annotation_note: Ordinary promotional offer without a suspicious action.

text: Subscribe to our monthly newsletter for product updates, event announcements and special offers.
label: spam
annotation_note: Unrequested marketing subscription invitation.

text: Tyohar ke mauke par kitchen items par special discount. Offer details showroom par uplabdh hain.
label: spam
annotation_note: Promotional message without impersonation or credential harvesting.

text: Hamari clothing store ki new collection aa gayi hai. Weekend par shopping offers available hain.
label: spam
annotation_note: Unsolicited clothing advertisement without a fraud request.

text: Explore our beginner photography course. New enrolments are open for the next batch.
label: spam
annotation_note: Ordinary course marketing message.

text: Naye residential project ke sample flats dekhne ke liye Sunday ko site visit karein.
label: spam
annotation_note: Unsolicited property advertisement without a deceptive payment demand.

text: Your bank account will be blocked today. Complete KYC immediately at https://account-check.example/kyc to avoid suspension.
label: scam
annotation_note: Threatens account blocking and directs the recipient to an unverified login destination.

text: Aapko payment receive karne ke liye UPI collect request approve karni hogi. Apna UPI PIN enter karein.
label: scam
annotation_note: Deceptively claims a PIN is needed to receive money and pressures the recipient to approve a request.

text: Parcel customs fee pending hai. Delivery cancel hone se pehle https://parcel-fee.example/pay par payment karein.
label: scam
annotation_note: Uses a delivery threat and an unverified payment link to obtain money.

text: Congratulations, you are selected for a remote job. Pay the mandatory registration fee today to confirm your offer.
label: scam
annotation_note: Uses a fake job offer to demand an upfront fee.

text: Guaranteed 30 percent monthly return. Transfer your first deposit today to unlock the investment plan.
label: scam
annotation_note: Promises unrealistic guaranteed returns and urges an immediate transfer.

text: Main tumhara cousin bol raha hoon. Mera phone kharab hai, urgent paise is naye UPI ID par bhej do aur ghar par kisi ko mat batana.
label: scam
annotation_note: Impersonates a relative
column9: requests money to a new identifier and demands secrecy.

text: Aaj raat aapki electricity supply cut ho jayegi. Connection bachane ke liye https://power-bill.example/urgent par details submit karein.
label: scam
annotation_note: Impersonates a utility and uses a disconnection threat with an unverified site.

text: You have won a cash prize. Pay a processing charge first to release the winnings to your account.
label: scam
annotation_note: Uses a prize claim to obtain an upfront payment.
